what: copies of a primitive cut made with a rectangular pattern change only the seed's targets, not a body the seed was told to leave alone
method: Plaque 100x60x10 loses three through holes r3 (seed at x=10, copies at 40 and 70, all inside the plate): 60000 - 3*pi*3^2*10. Voisin (z 5..15, overlapping the plate) and Loin are not targets, so they stay whole: 60000 and 1000. Total = 121000 - 3*pi*90
